scenes.title: Just One Copy on the Bottom Shelf
scenes.summary: On release day for their debut adult video, Kawada, Toshi, and Muranishi visit a rental shop eagerly—only to find a single tape tucked away on the bottom corner shelf.

scenes.title: Top-Notch Starlet, Lifeless Expression
scenes.summary: While popular starlet Miku brush off admirers at a glittering disco, Muranishi studies a rival Poseidon tape at the office and declares her expression lifeless despite her beauty.

scenes.title: Ikezawa and Detective Takei Are Connected
scenes.summary: Over cheap drinks at a street stall, Toshi vents frustration at rival Ikezawa's sales until yakuza boss Furuya reveals that Ikezawa and Detective Takei engineered Muranishi's Hokkaido arrest.

scenes.title: Opening title sequence
scenes.summary: Opening title sequence for Episode 4 of The Naked Director.

scenes.title: Saving Up to Gift Mom a Trip
scenes.summary: Waking to overdue bills after a night out in Tokyo, Miku phones her mother on the family farm, insisting her office job pays well and promising to save up for a vacation gift.

scenes.title: Fueling Up Before the Battle
scenes.summary: As the crew bickers over pickles touching rice at lunch, Muranishi quiets the table, praises the cooking, and remarks that a chef's skill determines whether fine ingredients live or die.

scenes.title: Crashing Poseidon's Anniversary Gala
scenes.summary: At Poseidon's lavish anniversary reception, Ikezawa preaches industry order until Muranishi heckles him from the buffet table and criticizes his starlet's robotic expression to her face.

scenes.title: An Advance Payment on Your True Worth
scenes.summary: Slipping into Miku's taxi after the party, Muranishi challenges her to live her own life rather than faking everything for Ikezawa and hands her half a million yen upfront.

scenes.title: Turning an Assistant's Home Into a Film Set
scenes.summary: With zero budget to rent a studio, Muranishi commandeers his assistant's apartment for Miku's shoot, while the makeup artist reassures the nervous actress she made the right choice.

scenes.title: I Will Not Force You—You Decide
scenes.summary: Dissatisfied with Miku's theatrical faking during the widow scene, Muranishi halts the camera, replaces the fleeing actor, and challenges Miku to choose genuine performance on her own terms.

scenes.title: Half-Hearted Desires Are Boring
scenes.summary: When college classmates tease Megumi Sahara for being a late bloomer, she unsettles them by asking whether her friend fakes passion and declares that desire without resolve is dull.

scenes.title: One Step Forward on the Rental Shelf
scenes.summary: Staking another million yen to capture Miku's radiant performance, Muranishi wraps an unconventional hit that wins prime shelf space—though the shop manager warns Poseidon will retaliate.
scenes.location: apartment set and rental video shop

scenes.title: Ikezawa's Chilling Dinner Parable
scenes.summary: Over fine French cuisine with his actresses, Ikezawa recounts watching a bold rival tape starring one of Poseidon's own girls and remarks coldly that her life is now over.

scenes.title: Detective Takei Raids the Disco
scenes.summary: Acting on Ikezawa's tip, Detective Takei storms the disco to haul Miku in and cruelly informs her he has already phoned her parents back home with every detail.

scenes.title: We Cannot Stop Filming Now
scenes.summary: Guilt-stricken after Miku retreats to the countryside, Muranishi is urged by Toshi to keep moving forward—just as Kawada rushes in to report tomorrow's actress abruptly canceled.

scenes.title: Mahjong Collusion and an Industry Blacklist
scenes.summary: Over a mahjong table, Furuya warns Ikezawa not to underestimate Muranishi's nerve while promising to keep him on a leash, as Kawada confirms every talent agency has frozen them out.
